# Imagery, Illustration, and Iconography

## Imagery (photography and video)

- **Art direction over stock:** define subject, light, color treatment, composition, and human
  presence; hold them consistently.
- **Real product over abstract:** a legible real UI or product photograph beats generic 3D art
  (Cursor CU1, Slack SL2, Apple AP3).
- **Product in life:** placing a product element inside a lifestyle photo shows use (Revolut RV1,
  Monzo MZ1).
- **Text on images:** scrims or solid backing; test contrast on the actual image.
- **Performance:** modern formats, responsive sources, lazy-load below the fold, reserved aspect
  ratio; never block the task on a hero image.
- **User-generated images:** normalize crops and backgrounds; design fallbacks.

## Illustration

| Job | Example |
|---|---|
| Explain | A diagram of how the system works |
| Establish a world | A travel line illustration above a search form (Google Flights G2) |
| Character and voice | A mascot with defined poses (Duolingo DU1, Grafana GF2) |
| Soften moments | Error and empty states, proportionately |
| Celebrate | Results and achievements |

Rules: one consistent style (line, fill, palette, perspective); proportion to the space (no
illustration pushing the action below the fold); decorative illustrations hidden from assistive
technology; no text baked into images.

**Slop signals:** floating 3D blobs, abstract spheres, people-at-laptops stock art, mixed styles.

## Iconography

- Icons label common, unambiguous actions (search, close, settings), disambiguate similar items
  (file types, statuses), and save space in dense toolbars with tooltips.
- Pair icons with labels in navigation and for important actions.
- Choose one icon style consistent with the shape language (stroke weight, corner treatment).
- Hand-drawn or custom icons can carry identity when consistent (The Pudding PU3).
- Icon-only toolbars are an expert trade-off (TradingView TV2); always provide accessible names and
  tooltips.
- **Slop signals:** an icon beside every heading repeating its text; icons in colored rounded
  squares on every feature card; sparkles meaning "AI".
